meta.name: flowkit
meta.description: Analyzes flow cytometry data with FlowKit, including spillover compensation, logicle and biexponential transforms, hierarchical gating, GatingML strategies, and supported FlowJo 10 workspaces. Use for reproducible gate counts, population percentages, gated fluorescence summaries, or reproducing a FlowJo analysis in Python. For FCS metadata inspection or file-format repair alone, use FlowIO.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把流式细胞仪数据做成可复现的门控计数与荧光摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要用 Python 复现 FlowJo 的流式细胞分析结果。
copy.tagline_en: Turn flow cytometry data into reproducible gate counts and fluorescence summaries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to reproduce FlowJo flow cytometry analysis in Python.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 FlowKit 分析流式细胞术 FCS 文件：做溢漏补偿、logicle 等变换、层级门控，复现 FlowJo 工作区分析，并输出含各门计数、父门计数与群体百分比的 CSV 和溯源文件。
howto.when: 当你需要可复现的门计数、群体百分比等结果，或要在 Python 里复现 FlowJo 分析时使用；仅检查 FCS 元数据或修复文件格式请改用 FlowIO。
howto.what_en: With FlowKit installed, Claude analyzes flow cytometry FCS files: compensation, transforms, hierarchical gating, and reproducing supported FlowJo workspaces. It writes gate_report.csv and provenance.json with gate counts and percentages.
howto.when_en: Use when you need reproducible gate counts, population percentages, or to reproduce a FlowJo analysis in Python. For FCS metadata inspection or file-format repair only, use FlowIO.

say_en.text: Analyze sample.fcs with FlowKit using the gates.xml strategy and export counts
Reproduce study.wsp in Python with FlowKit and report population percentages
say_en.note: Needs every FCS file in the selected group

say_en.text: Explain the difference between absolute_percent and relative_percent
say_en.note: absolute_percent = all events; relative_percent = parent gate
